description: CSS filters in the CPU renderer (forked vello_cpu and anyrender_vello_cpu): each filter function (brightness, contrast, grayscale, hue-rotate with a nested invert, invert, opacity, saturate, sepia, blur), hard and soft drop shadows, filter lists (colour functions; blur, drop shadow and sepia), a filter under opacity, and a filter transition sampled mid-way; every cell is a pixel region
